name: Be a Shark🦈
desc:
If you don't like being eaten, private servers are free!

Become a Shark - new shark simulator and tycoon!

- Eat fish to become bigger
- Eat other sharks to become bigger
- Eat other players to earn Skulls
- Earn and collect rare shark skins
- Trade shark skins with others

Premium benefits: Premium players get +100 starting Skulls

New updates weekly! Follow the game so you don't miss out!

LIKE, FAVORITE, and JOIN the group for a special in-game skin

Made by Protori, Giffcookiegaming, MaxReax, and DevFrigid
